GLASS_BASE_FAULTLINE_MARKS.why: Faultline Marks: 'You can have a number of Faultline Marks active at one time equal to your Proficiency Bonus' (combat/ext/elements_marks.py's generic mark_caps compile_block; combat/typed_executor.py's block_mark already ends the oldest past the cap once one is registered).

TAL_YIN_MARK_LIMIT.why: Mark Limit: 'You can maintain a number of Waning Marks equal to your Proficiency Bonus' (combat/ext/elements_marks.py's generic mark_caps compile_block).

TAL_EARTH_BURDEN_THE_BLADE.why: Burden the Blade: a third-party's hit (whichever creature carries your Burden Mark), not your own attack -- automated via the attack_resolved hook in combat/ext/elements_earth.py rather than factory_compiler's modifier-variant system.
